---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new feature
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem you're trying to solve

Describe the user-facing problem. Not the solution yet — the problem.

## Who experiences this

What role uses this? Admin, analyst, auditor, integrator?

## Proposed approach

Optional. If you have an implementation idea, sketch it. If not, that's fine — the problem statement is the more valuable part.

## Alternatives considered

What's the workaround today? Why is it insufficient?

## Scope

- [ ] This affects the public OSS surface in this repository.
- [ ] This affects only the documentation.
- [ ] This affects production internals (likely out of scope for this repo — see `OSS_SAFE.md`).

## Additional context

Links, mockups, anything that helps.
